criteria.summary: 31 unique points and four-part mappings complete; two justified additions.
HTTP and unknown data precede session, authorization and SSR; optional protocols explicit.
Primary sources and exact baseline versions checked; browser, HTTP, credential and server boundaries distinguished.
Real HTTP, crypto, CORS, realtime, SSR and browser checks; observation-only integrations explicit.
Concrete independent variants, acceptance checks, reproducible faults and reference material per point.
Tasks match actual Nuxt or separate labs; statuses, limits, existing features and extensions distinguished.
Names, source, contracts and examples agree; shared session defaults and identity scopes reviewed.
Required findings closed; final six integration tests and thirteen units passed with empty unexpected server error log.
284 of 587 authored, indexes and limits synchronized; learner checkboxes unchanged.

findings.resolution: Safe retry/idempotency and SSR session/private cache added with rationale.
Common default factory and epoch/csrf/account guard, including failure, plus private cache cleanup.
Array text assertion retries asynchronous list changes; no sleep.
Non-destroying iterator return and unbuffered drain fixed Nitro socket exception; exception monitor and final six tests passed.
Direct foreign PATCH rejected and original Bob data remained unchanged.
Main upload200/saved:false versus separate lab201/stored:false, local Blob versus HTTP download, real versus extension separated.

limitations: Local public demo accounts, HTTP cookie Secure=false and in-memory stores are not production identity infrastructure.
No real OAuth/SSO provider, GraphQL/grpc-web service, production TLS, persistence, deployment or load test.
Headless Chrome simulated viewports, not real mobile, cross-browser, assistive technology or human learner trial.
